fact: Ordinances 0011, 0012 and 0013/PR/2026, signed 26 February 2026 and published in the Journal Officiel of 8 April 2026, make deepfakes punishable with up to ten years' imprisonment and a 50 million FCFA fine for offences committed by AI, and widen the HAC's missions to regulating social networks.
title: Numérique au Gabon : 7 choses à savoir sur les trois ordonnances qui changent tout
